query:
SELECT a.attachment_id AS "attachment_id: AttachmentId"
            FROM attachment a
            JOIN message m ON m.message_id = a.message_id
            LEFT JOIN chat_message_queue q ON q.message_id = a.message_id
            WHERE a.status = ?1
                AND a.created_at < ?2
                AND m.sent = 0
                AND q.message_id IS NULL
